title: MALIBU Benchmark: Multi-Agent LLM Implicit Bias Uncovered

bias_targets.methodology: Assigning male or female persona labels to identical generated responses and using an LLM-based multi-agent judging system to score them independently and compare them contrastively across metrics like creativity, accuracy, efficiency, and reliability.

Assigning racial or ethnic persona labels (Black, White, Asian, Hispanic) to identical generated responses and evaluating them through an LLM-based multi-agent judging system using single-candidate scoring and contrastive pair comparisons.

Assigning religious persona labels (Muslim, Jewish, Christian, Atheist) to identical generated responses and evaluating them through an LLM-based multi-agent judging system using single-candidate scoring and contrastive pair comparisons.
